The ratio of SAC's ISE to TD3's ISE for the case of Feed A and Feed B flow rates is 660.505 / 103.053 = 6.41.

The ratio of SAC's ISE to TD3's ISE for the case of Feed B temperature and Feed A flow rate is 163.651 / 161.098 = 1.016.

The ratio of SAC's ISE to TD3's ISE for the case of Feed A flow rate and Feed B flow rate is 660.505 / 103.053 = 6.41.

The ratio of SAC's ISE to TD3's ISE for the case of Hot Oil Bath and Feed A temperature is 164.772 / 160.685 = 1.026.

The ratio of SAC's ISE to TD3's ISE for the case of Hot Oil Bath and Feed B temperature is 168.345 / 164.257 = 1.025.

The ratio of SAC's ISE to TD3's ISE for the case of Hot Oil Bath and Feed B flow rate is 162.243 / 160.480 = 1.009.

Therefore, the ratio of SAC's ISE to TD3's ISE for the case of Feed A and Feed B flow rates is approximately 6.41 times larger.
